column1: # The diary tier that grants each tiered reward item, and the varbit that counts the item's
# teleports spent today where the game keeps one. The highest completed tier of a family
# names what the player holds. The name beside each varbit is its RuneLite VarbitID constant.
# 4552 counts the Explorer's ring's cabbage-patch teleports (4553 counts energy restores,
# 4554 free alchs). Varbit 6069 (ARDOUGNE_CLOAK_LOWBITS) is a single bit and cannot hold
# the cloak's three or five daily farm teleports, so the cloak's uses are counted as they
# Cloak 1 matters because its Monastery teleport lands beside a fairy ring.
# Only the elite legs teleport to the slime pit without limit, so the lower tiers have no row.
# 7937 counts Rada's blessing's Kourend Woodland teleports, the first three bits of varp
# kebos_blessing_tracker, for the easy and the medium blessing alike, so the medium one is
# rationed as the easy one: three a day where the game allows five. The elite blessing
# teleports there as the hard one does, without limit.
